text: As required for compliance with Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Statement of Investment Objectives and Principles (SIOP), benchmarks for each asset class are recommended for Board approval. The performance of Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s investments are compared against these benchmarks on a regular basis.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the benchmark for each asset class as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (October 20, 2022) from the Vice President, Impact Investing, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
